description: NaLa(CO₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.61 Å. La is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of La-O bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.68 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. All C-O bond lengths are 1.30 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one La, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two equivalent La, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two equivalent La and one C atom.
